PluginData.Tooltip: Replaces planet CloudSphere layers with raymarched volumetric clouds (requires Anomaly).
PluginData.Description:
Replaces Keen's textured planet cloud layers with spherical raymarched volumetric clouds.
Requires the Anomaly Shader Framework. Configure under Anomaly Shaders → Volumetric Clouds → Settings (Rich HUD Master) or the Pulsar plugin dialog.
For support please join the Pulsar Discord: https://discord.gg/z8ZczP2YZY
